verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities. Sellers' payouts can be managed via Dashboard or API, which may cover pausing payouts. Disputes can be monitored and acted on, a loose per-seller risk signal. Webhooks and notification settings offer a generic alerting channel. Nothing documents fraud or credit-risk scoring per sub-merchant, anomaly alerts, or offboarding. Missing for 10: per-sub-merchant fraud/credit-risk signals, anomalous-seller alerting, explicit payout-hold/pause controls, seller offboarding/disable tooling, independent corroboration.
